conventions.raw: animation index in the sprite def (def+0x50 + 4*raw) = sprites.json raw_index; SetAnim(id) shows raw table[id] + 1, SetAnimRaw(n) shows raw n + 1
conventions.tick: logic ticks (one game update; video lag frames removed). A state entered by the AI shows its first frame with tick 0 on the entering tick; one entered from another actor (a hit) has already ticked once (tick 1)
conventions.order: per tick an enemy runs: the +0x18 controller, the state tick (vtable +4; may end -> SetAnim(0)), then the AI tree
conventions.sequence: custom controllers: [raw, frame, ticks] run-lengths from the entering tick to the last tick before the next SetState

ticks.once: 0x0800DE6C: tick += 1; f = tick >> shift; f >= nframes -> end callback (vtable +0x24), frame unchanged; else frame = f
ticks.loop: 0x0800DEB0: tick += 1; f = tick >> shift; f >= nframes -> tick = 0, f = 0; frame = f
ticks.idle: 0x0800DFD4: tick += 1; nframes == 2: frame = (tick & 0xFF) > 0xF0 ? 1 : 0 (blink 15 of 256); else frame = (tick >> 3) & 0xFF, past the end -> frame = tick = 0
ticks.bored: 0x0800DF8A: tick += 1; f = tick >> 5; f >= nframes -> tick = 0x40, frame = 2; else frame = f
ticks.reverse: 0x08018C24 / 0x0802F224: tick -= 1; tick < 0 -> tick = nframes * 8 - 1; frame = tick >> 3 (the walk cycle played backwards, 8 ticks per frame)
